notes: LESEMAGAZIN: Der Reise-Blog von Anja Ebner (UNTERWEGS). All printed words reviewed at 2x: blog header (Der Reise-Blog von Anja Ebner via 4x zoom), LINKS sidebar (10 links incl. hyphen-wrapped Frühlings-/Orchester-wochenende kept split as printed), four dated blog entries (dates/times 12./22:15, 13./15:30, 14./10:30, 14./12 Uhr and inline numbers 12, 15, 2000, 10 recovered via 8x zoom OCR; line-break hyphens losgefah-/ren, geschla-/fen, Mann-/heims, biss-/chen, Hau-/se kept as printed), comment thread (incl. both "0 Kommentare / Kommentar schreiben" lines after entries 2 and 4) (Speyerfan_92, LG Pit, 1 Kommentar / 0 Kommentare counters), three photo captions, task 1 and task 2 instructions.

Fields: task 2 = 4 write-in blanks under images 2-5 (Wochentage), answers key-verified (official Hueber key, Lesemagazin 2: Samstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag) and consistent with the blog text (tanzen "gestern" written Sonntag -> Samstag; Hotel Freitag; einkaufen Samstag; Schlosspark Sonntag). Image 1 carries the printed handwriting example Freitag (word, not a field). Blank lines measured via connected components. Task 1 (Welcher Link passt?) is a marking task with no printed blank, so no field; its answer per key is "Mein Frühlingswochenende am Rhein".

No audio markers on the page. Excluded per policy: LESEMAGAZIN gold outline header, red task numerals 1/2, yellow "Unterwegs" script artwork on the banner, photos, Kommentar divider dots, slashes between link texts, footer (neunundsechzig/69, Modul tab), facing-page bleed.
